subject: Display pedestal sparking at Booth 42 — mitigation & cellular fallback
messages:
From: Marcus Liao <marcus@eventcore-av.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: ops@lakesidecenter.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: URGENT: Display pedestal electrical spark at Booth 42 — immediate mitigation

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

We just had a small electrical spark from the pedestal display at Booth 42 (the LED demo panel). No one is hurt, but there was visible arcing and light smoke. I cut power at the local breaker and pulled the pedestal from the floor. The venue's fire suppressor briefly engaged but no larger alarm.

Immediate questions:
- Can Redwood confirm that we should move all live demo traffic to the backup tablets on cellular (4G) now?
- Do you want EventCore to remove the hardware from the booth or wait for the venue electrician?

I attached a close-up photo of the burned terminal (spark-closeup.jpg). I'm standing by on the floor for direction.

Marcus
EventCore AV — Onsite Lead
marcus@eventcore-av.com
(415) 555-0187
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marcus Liao <marcus@eventcore-av.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>, ops@lakesidecenter.com
Date: 2026-10-15T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Display pedestal electrical spark at Booth 42 — immediate mitigation

Marcus — thanks for the heads up and the photo.

Please do the following immediately:
1) Keep the booth powered down and cordon the area — no demo activity until electrician signs off.
2) Route all inbound demo traffic to the backup tablets (serials attached to this thread) over the 4G hotspot we pre-provisioned. Marissa — can you confirm the SIMs are active and the APN?
3) Photograph the serial numbers and any visible damage and upload to the incident folder.
4) Hold onto the damaged pedestal. If the venue electrician can replace the terminal safely on-site, fine — otherwise we'll take hardware back after the event.

I'll notify the sponsor contact and request replacement hardware/credit if needed. Tessa — please push for an extra 20 minutes of demo time for nearby sessions so we can catch up.

Subject: Re: URGENT: Display pedestal electrical spark at Booth 42 — immediate mitigation

Jonas / Marissa —

Confirmed: breaker off, fire suppressor triggered a short burst but no water discharge. I attached two files: spark-closeup.jpg and backup-tablet-serials.csv (list of tablets we moved demos to). We spun up the 4G hotspot and the lead demo tablet shows connected — I tested a sample chat prompt and it streamed over cellular.

EventCore will leave the pedestal on-site unless you want us to remove it. Electrician ETA from venue is ~30 minutes.

--Marcus
(Onsite)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marcus Liao <marcus@eventcore-av.com>, Kathy Burns <kathy.burns@liveops.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Display pedestal electrical spark at Booth 42 — mitigation & cellular fallback

Jonas / team — good job getting traffic moved. A couple of follow-ups for ops and sponsor coordination: 

- Kathy (LiveOps) — sorry, your demo was interrupted. We recommend providing a 15–20 minute make-good slot later today; can your team confirm availability?
- Marcus — please invoice any consumables or immediate labor to EventCore; if Redwood ends up covering a hardware replacement we will coordinate credit requests with LiveOps post-event.
- Tessa — please coordinate signage fix (temporary banner) and have shipping tag ready if we need to pull the pedestal.

I also want an internal incident brief after the show: brief timeline, root cause (loose terminal looks likely), and corrective actions for future booth builds.

Marissa Cole
Senior Field Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>
To: ops@lakesidecenter.com, Marcus Liao <marcus@eventcore-av.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Display pedestal electrical spark at Booth 42 — mitigation & cellular fallback

Venue Ops / Marcus — can you confirm electrician on-site and provide ETA? Also confirm whether venue will generate an incident report (preferred) or if EventCore should file one.

Quick summary for the electrician: loose terminal at lower power block, visible scorch marks on connector (see photo). Please prioritize safety checks on nearby booths, especially shared power rails.

Jonas

On Fri, Oct 15, 2026 at 9:35 AM Marcus Liao <marcus@eventcore-av.com> wrote:
> Confirmed: breaker off, fire suppressor triggered a short burst but no water discharge...
From: Venue Ops <ops@lakesidecenter.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Marcus Liao <marcus@eventcore-av.com>
Date: 2026-10-15T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: URGENT: Display pedestal electrical spark at Booth 42 — mitigation & cellular fallback

Jonas / Marissa / Marcus —

Electrician arrived at 10:46 and replaced the loose terminal and tightened downstream connectors. We ran a full continuity test on the circuit and confirmed integrity; no other faults found. The small scorch on the connector was consistent with a loose lug — cause recorded. We generated an incident report (attached: lakeside-incident-report-20261015.pdf).

We will bill EventCore AV for the electrician labor per standard venue policy; please coordinate with EventCore on settlement.

Best,
